description: Held-out labeled questions for measuring learning-corpus routing accuracy. Deliberately DISTINCT from seed-learning.json (paraphrases, not copies) so retrieval cannot trivially match a question to itself — this measures how well the corpus GENERALIZES. Each case is { question, tools: [ the tool(s) that should answer it ] }; a match is the expected tool appearing in the top retrieved pattern. Additive and version-tolerant: newer readers may add fields; older readers ignore unknown ones. Extend this set over time (more cases = a more trustworthy accuracy number).
